the XL+-tree is a good alternative to the R-tree for XML query processing.

the design and analysis of an index structure, XL+-tree, for XML data in external memory.
indexing XML documents for the efficient evaluation of XPath queries in external memory.

the XL+-tree outperforms R-tree by a factor of 2.0 to 3.5, which is significant in terms of query processing.
